toegepas.rede_vinder: A span of generations is idiomatically 'oor ... heen'; bare 'oor baie geslagte' reads as 'about many generations'.
toegepas.fout: 'oor baie geslagte oorvertel' can be read as 'retold about many generations'.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'oor ... heen' is the natural fixed form for a span of generations and removes the ambiguity without moving the meaning.

toegepas.rede_vinder: 'hulle versier' after 'mense gewerk' can read as decorating some other thing; 'hulself' makes the reflexive clear.
toegepas.fout: 'en hulle versier het' after 'mense gewerk' can first be read as a new subject 'they' or as decorating something else.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'hulself' makes the reflexive unmistakable for a Grade 5 reader and says the same thing.

toegepas.voor: Die prente wys mense wat jag en dans, en ook dinge wat hulle geglo het.
toegepas.na: Die prente wys mense wat jag en dans. Hulle wys ook dinge wat die mense geglo het.
toegepas.rede_vinder: AWS allows no comma before 'en' within one sentence, and dropping it makes 'jag en dans en ook dinge' ambiguous, so split into two sentences.
toegepas.fout: A comma before 'en' between parts of one sentence breaks the AWS rule, and 'hulle' could point to the pictures or the people.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Two short sentences fix the punctuation and the pronoun, with the same content in the same order.

toegepas.na: dus wys hierdie navorsing nie presies
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'dit' has no clear antecedent (leefwyses is plural); naming the research makes the reference clear.
toegepas.fout: 'dit' follows plural 'Leefwyses' and has no clear antecedent.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Naming the research makes the reference clear and matches the previous sentence's 'Hierdie manier van navorsing' without changing the claim.

toegepas.na: saam vertel hulle ons die meeste
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'vertel' without an indirect object sounds unfinished here.
toegepas.fout: 'saam vertel hulle die meeste' sounds unfinished without the indirect object.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'vertel hulle ons die meeste' is what a fluent writer would write, and the meaning is unchanged.

laat_vaar.voor: Navorsers leer ook deur mense wat vandag leef dop te hou
laat_vaar.na: Navorsers leer ook meer deur mense wat vandag leef, dop te hou
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'leer ook' needs an object to read naturally, and a comma after the embedded relative clause helps a Grade 5 reader find the verb.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'leer' needs no object, 'meer' adds a comparison the original does not make, and the comma splits the 'deur ... dop te hou' construction.

na_skrywer.voor: wat ons oor nou en oor lank gelede vertel
na_skrywer.na: wat ons van vandag en van lank gelede vertel
na_skrywer.rede_vinder: 'oor nou' is unidiomatic; 'vertel van vandag en van lank gelede' is natural Afrikaans with the same meaning.
na_skrywer.fout: 'oor nou' in the bronne definition is unidiomatic Afrikaans.
na_skrywer.rede_keurder: The fault is real, but this is a glossary definition shared across lessons, so the writer must reword it for every lesson at once.
na_skrywer.waarom: the reviewer sent it to the writer

na_skrywer.rede_vinder: 'groep' alone is vague and the following 'hulle' needs people as its referent.
na_skrywer.fout: 'n groep' in the etnografie definition is vague when the entry is read alone, and 'hulle' has no people to refer to.
na_skrywer.rede_keurder: Adding 'mense' rewords a glossary definition beyond spelling or grammar, so the writer decides it.
na_skrywer.waarom: the reviewer sent it to the writer

vlae.teks: Rotskuns of rotstekeninge is prente wat mense op rotse geskilder of in die klip ingekerf het.
vlae.rede: The protected decision for 'rotskuns' says 'prente' was avoided because a later lesson teaches that herders' rock art is geometric patterns 'in plaas van prente'; this study sentence still defines rock art as 'prente'. Content question for the writer, not changed.

vlae.teks: Voorwerpe (artefakte) is dinge wat mense gemaak of gebruik het.
vlae.rede: The study text says artefacts are things people made or USED, while the glossary says made or ALTERED; a learner gets two answers in one lesson. Content question, not changed.
